war_summary: War 139 is on day 131 with no winner yet (32 victory towns required). The map remains heavily consolidated in rear areas — Colonials fully hold Acrithia, Dead Lands, Drowned Vale, Fisherman's Row and many others; Wardens fully hold Basin Sionnach, Clanshead Valley, Viper Pit, Reaching Trail and Weathered Expanse — while a handful of contested fronts drive nearly all activity. Compared to the prior snapshot (~3h ago), Callahan's Passage remains the hottest front: ~7-8k casualties/24h per side with 1h rates cooling from a prior surge to ~150-290/hr but 2h rates still elevated (~320-470/hr); split is now 6-4 Colonial after fresh flips at Lochan Berth and Solas Gorge (latest event ~3h before cutoff). Clahstra has re-escalated sharply: 2h casualty rates surged to ~670-810/hr (accelerating), ~12-14k casualties/24h each side, with heavy churn — 29 events/24h including 7 neutralizations and captures by both sides at Transept, Bewailing Fort, Weephome and East Narthex; latest event minutes before cutoff; split 5-3 Warden. Speaking Woods shows sustained very heavy fighting (~860-890/hr per side over 2h, accelerating; ~12k casualties/24h each) with recent activity at The Filament, Hush and Stem; split 5-3 Warden. Endless Shore continues churning hard — 50 events/24h around Brackish Point, Saltbrook Channel, Woodbind, Tuatha Watchpost and The Overland, with 2h rates re-accelerating to ~110-120/hr and the latest event at cutoff; it stands 8-2 Colonial. Onyx remains extremely intense (~920-935/hr per side over 2h, accelerating) with The Waif as the hotspot (9 events/24h), split 5-1 Colonial. Oarbreaker stays very active (37 events/24h at Grisly Refuge, Gold, Posterus, Fort Fogwood, Silver) though 1h rates cooled sharply before re-accelerating over 2h; split 8-1 Colonial. Marban Hollow shows warden-heavy fighting (~119-264/hr over 2h, accelerating) with 10 events/24h at Sanctum and Lockheed, 4-4. Godcrofts is active (21 events/24h around Argosa, Saegio, Lipsia) but cooling from its prior surge; 7-2 Colonial. StemaLanding shows renewed activity (10 events/24h at The Flair and Verge Wing, latest event at cutoff). Mooring County, Tempest Island, Tyrant Foothills and Nevish Line show moderate ongoing activity. Quiet rear hexes remain static.
